note: Winter cloakroom off the accessories room. Feminine left (granny in fluffy slippers with a pan too full of pancakes, Roman lady in a tunic playing a tune, posh lady with a sequinned clutch, shop assistant pointing at a girl's shoe size), masculine right (man in a raincoat under the watering can, little capuchin friar boy with his hood, two men in nose-and-glasses disguises at the hatstand, father with his son's bootees, poor knight in a doublet, toy car parked in a court shoe, polo boy on a hobby horse, cowboy stacking textiles, porter wheeling the ready-to-wear rail, dapper man on his step checking his clothes in the mirror for vestimentaire). Door at the left back to the accessories room.
